en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I should go to the casino.
I did promise Miu...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's all over the place...
But I shouldn't just leave them be.

<CLT=cltMIND>There has to be something I can do...
Yes, I'm going to do something about this!
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to rest in bed?
Free Time will end if you do.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why all the uniforms...?
They could at least give me some casual clothes.

<CLT=cltMIND>We promised not to tell each other
who has whose <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltMIND>.
